codes.description: Operating surgeon not present or not scrubbed when the room was ready.
Anaesthetist unavailable, difficult induction, pre-op assessment incomplete, line or block taking longer than planned.
Instrument tray missing, short, wet, unsterile, or still being reprocessed by CSSD.
Patient not fasted, not changed, not marked, investigations pending, or still on the ward being prepared.
Consent form unsigned, wrong procedure named, or relative not available to countersign.
The preceding case in the same theatre ran past its scheduled finish.
No porter available, trolley unavailable, lift out of service, patient still in transit.
Cross-match pending, units not issued, blood bank turnaround.
Scope, diathermy, C-arm, laparoscopy stack, microscope or table fault; consumable missing.
No post-op critical care bed, so the case cannot safely start.
Anything that does not clearly fit the ten codes above. Used as the fallback whenever the model is unsure.
